slides.title: Distancing structures
slides.subtitle: It would appear that… / There seems to be…
goals: Write in academic and journalistic style.

head: Structure
Example
rows: **It would appear that** the data is incomplete.
It is said / reported / alleged that
**It is alleged that** he accepted bribes.

items.q: ___ to be a problem with your account.
It ___ appear that the meeting has been cancelled.
The suspect is ___ to have fled the country.
